entries.subject: DAMIT 5901: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-5901.txt. Model 5901, version 2019-10-23, pole (28°, 29°), period 22.836 h match the retained metadata. The archive supplies no diameter for this model; a separate scale constraint is required. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: The retained calibration uses 16.848 ±0.182 km. effective body diameter

entries.subject: Other DAMIT shape solutions
entries.finding: The live DAMIT export lists these other models for this target: 5902: pole (199°, 24°), 22.837 h, version 2019-10-23. These are archive alternatives, not necessarily newly released models or preferred replacements. Comparing their source methods and any pole-specific calibration remains necessary before changing the selected mesh.
entries.revisitWhen: Independent shape, spin or scale evidence distinguishes these alternatives, or a changed release offers a demonstrably better supported model.
